description: Agent Veterinary Records: submit veterinary lab records with the lab orders and treatment record they answer to: the reading moment; each lab order entry with its id, reference, the animal, the test ordered and the moment ordered; each lab result entry with its id, reference, the order it answers, the animal, the test resulted, the moment resulted and the moment the result calls for a repeat test; each treatment entry citing a lab result with its id, reference, the result cited, the animal and the moment recorded. The signed report gives the lab results and the records behind them, each result against the order entry behind it, each lab entry against its animal and its date, each result the treatment record cites against the lab record, and each repeat test a result calls for against a later entry of the same test for the same animal, and counts them, and names divergent lab records: a lab result recorded with no order entry behind it, a lab entry missing the animal or the date, a result the treatment record cites that the lab record does not contain, and a repeat test the result itself calls for with no later entry; then a lab order with no result behind it and a lab result dated before its order, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No lab result entries, or no lab order entries beside results, leaves those points unverified. Orders, results, citations and animals match by letters and digits, tests by their words with plurals folded, so Chemistry panels and chemistry panel are one test, dates read by the day, a result naming no order rests on an order of its test for its animal, and a repeat due after the reading moment waits. This reads a veterinary practice’s lab record: wever_health-lab-check reads a lab summary against the printed report, while the veterinary lab record check reads whether every lab result the practice holds answers an order, names its animal and date, backs each citation in the treatment record and has its repeat test recorded. Verdict vet_lab_record_divergent, vet_lab_record_partial, vet_lab_record_unverified or vet_lab_record_consistent. POST /api/vet-lab-record-check. Reads the veterinary practice records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it treats no animal, contacts no regulator, pharmacy or other practice and issues no license, prescription or certification, which stay with the practice, its veterinarians and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Veterinary Records reads a veterinary practice’s own records: animal records, vaccination records, treatment records with dental procedures as treatment entries, surgery records, prescription records, lab records, veterinarian license records and controlled substance log records, each against the vaccination, treatment, visit and identity records, the rabies currency dates and booster schedule the record states, the visit, diagnosis, discharge and prescription records, the admission, anesthesia and recovery entries, the refill counts and the controlled substance log, the lab orders, the signed practice records and license classes, or the log’s own totals and inventory counts on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the practice: what the animal record shows, what the treatment and surgery records support, what the license record covers, and whether the prescription records and controlled substance logs hold up; it reads records held by a veterinary practice or clinic, whatever the species, not farm production records and not human healthcare records: the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s production records, herd treatments the farm itself recorded included, and the Agent Healthcare family reads human healthcare records, while this family reads a veterinary practice’s own records and reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-veterinary-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-veterinary-records/.

citations.description: Each treatment record entry that cites a lab result.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

repeat_due_at.description: When the result calls for a repeat test, such as 2026-03-02.
